#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""One-off cleanup tool for build artifacts."""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

if len(sys.argv) != 2:
    sys.exit("usage: cleanup.py <target-dir>")

files = [p for p in Path(sys.argv[1]).rglob("*") if p.is_file()]
for path in files:
    path.unlink()
print("deleted %d file(s)" % len(files))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""One-off cleanup tool for build artifacts."""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

if len(sys.argv) != 2:
    sys.exit("usage: cleanup.py <target-dir>")

deleted = 0
for path in sorted(Path(sys.argv[1]).rglob("*")):
    if path.is_file():
        path.unlink()
        print("deleted", path)
        deleted += 1
print("deleted %d file(s)" % deleted)
